mapper.sql: m.id, m.match_pair_id AS matchPairId, m.topic, m.start_time AS startTime, m.end_time AS endTime, m.meeting_link AS meetingLink, m.created_by AS createdBy, m.status, m.update_time AS updateTime
mapper.select: SELECT , mp.student_id AS studentId, mp.teacher_id AS teacherId FROM meeting m JOIN match_pair mp ON m.match_pair_id = mp.id WHERE m.id = #{meetingId}

SELECT
FROM meeting m JOIN match_pair mp ON m.match_pair_id = mp.id WHERE mp.teacher_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.start_time DESC

SELECT
FROM meeting m JOIN match_pair mp ON m.match_pair_id = mp.id WHERE mp.student_id = #{userId} ORDER BY m.start_time DESC
